title: ACME Conductor CertificateReconcileResult v1alpha1
description: Output of one acme-runner execution. The contract carries only logical references: ASCII FQDNs only (no internationalized domain names, not repeated here), no secrets, private keys or certificate bodies. storeObjectRef is a logical, versionless reference to the stored object, never a URL with credentials or a file system path. error.summary MUST NOT contain command lines, environment dumps, credentials, key material or certificate bodies. Go validation (pkg/api/v1alpha1) is authoritative and stricter than this schema; see schemas/README.md.

expiresAt.description: NotAfter of the certificate currently in the store, if known. Omitted when the run failed before a certificate existed. Go validation additionally rejects the zero time value, which is not expressible as a JSON Schema format constraint.

fingerprintSha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the DER certificate currently in the store, if known.

storeObjectRef.description: Provider-independent logical object name (for example a Key Vault certificate name). Never a URL, URI, path, query string or credential; consecutive dots ("..") are rejected by both this schema and Go validation. The 128-character bound is chosen to cover Azure Key Vault certificate names, which are 1..127 characters.

finishedAt.description: Must not be before startedAt. This cross-field ordering rule is enforced only by Go validation, not by this schema.

error.description: Null on success, required (non-null) on failure.

accountProvisioning.description: Present iff the job carried acme.account.provisioning and the Runner attempted to open it. Independent of status/action: a run can register the account and still fail the certificate issuance that followed.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary. MUST NOT contain command lines, environment dumps, credentials, key material or certificate bodies: summaries MUST come from Runner-owned templates, never copied from raw external output. Go validation additionally rejects control characters, blank-after-trim text and known secret markers (e.g. PEM headers, bearer tokens; header and key=value markers are matched case-insensitively). That marker check is a best-effort defense-in-depth heuristic, not a secret detector, and is not expressible in JSON Schema.
